description: Puntos de recarga de coches eléctricos is a dataset listed in datos.gob.es, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Ayuntamiento de Pozuelo de Alarcón. List of the location of electric car charging points in the municipality. Coverage: Ayuntamiento de Pozuelo de Alarcón. The portal shows the English title as "Electric car charging points" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Ayuntamiento de Pozuelo de Alarcón. The listing shows 2025-03-12 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://opendefinition.org/od/2.1/en/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-datos-gob-es.
